title: Twin-Array Rooftop Station
description: One static rooftop-station scene for the original renewable rooftop program. Two complete existing tilted eight-cell solar racks sit side by side on a thick isolated roof-deck cutaway. One complete existing finned inverter cabinet, one complete open twin-battery box with its original two battery exteriors and raised lid, and one complete empty perforated cable-tray segment form a separated front equipment strip. Four unique old assets, five whole instances, original unit scale, untouched raw GLB POSITION/NORMAL/index buffers, internal hierarchy and all PBR. Only the connected thick roof deck and low cutaway parapets are new scene-only geometry. Conservative central/front/side empty strips connect around the equipment; every old full finite sole remains supported on the deck. Different from the original ground-mounted wind/solar off-grid corner: no turbine, paired rooftop arrays and separate front equipment strip. One scene, zero new independent models. The cable tray is deliberately empty and not connected to devices; no cables, wiring, electrical continuity, solar generation, voltage, capacity, performance, installation, structural loading, roof waterproofing, access compliance, fire safety or functional compatibility is claimed. The opaque blank inverter display is original, not a newly counted control meter.
